en.description:
Real heads-up Texas Hold’em on Apple Watch.

Mini Poker is a complete 1-on-1 game of No-Limit Hold’em. You’re the Hero, across the table from an AI Villain, with real betting rounds and every hand running to a proper showdown — all on your wrist, no phone needed.

HOW IT PLAYS • Heads-up, you vs the AI — real check, call, raise, fold and all-in betting • Escalating blinds — the blinds double as the match goes on, with a ceiling that keeps late hands playable, so every match builds toward a finish • Choose your edge — start Easy, Medium or Hard by setting the opening stacks • Full showdown poker — complete hand evaluation, from high card to royal flush

BUILT FOR THE WATCH • Dial in your bet with the Digital Crown and play a whole hand in a tap or two • No phone required — everything runs on the watch

FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS Waiting for coffee, standing in a queue, killing two minutes — Mini Poker deals you a real hand of cards without the ceremony of a full casino app.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO WI-FI NEEDED Everything runs on-device. Raise your wrist and deal.
en.releaseNotes:
A sharper Villain.

• The Villain now plays pocket pairs before the flop instead of folding the small ones — expect more contested pots • Under the hood: a rebuilt betting engine, now covered by automated tests, so future updates land without breaking the rules you play by
en.subtitle: Heads-up Hold'em on your wrist
